periods.time: Opening day of the 62nd Seven Stars Sword-Art Festival

name.zh: 七星剑武祭开幕与史黛菈迟到
name.en: Seven Stars Opens and Stella Is Delayed

periods.location: Osaka Bay Dome; Hagun hospital broadcast room
periods.summary: The tournament formally opens with thirty-two representatives from eight schools. In Hagun's hospital, Toka wakes and watches the broadcast with Kanata. Stella's scheduled B-block match with Mikoto Tsuruya is postponed because Stella's train is delayed by a rockslide.
periods.cause: Stella continued training until the last moment and was caught by a railway accident instead of arriving with the other representatives.
periods.process: The committee confirms the delay and refuses Mikoto's request for an immediate forfeit victory. The broadcast then moves to C-block, where Ikki's match against Moroboshi approaches.
periods.outcome: Stella remains eligible to fight later that day; Toka analyzes Ikki's odds against Moroboshi from her hospital bed.
periods.significance: Launches the tournament proper, restores Toka to the narrative as analyst, and sets up Stella's later self-imposed penalty.
